prompt: pairs.py has a bug. pairs(items) must return every pair of DISTINCT POSITIONS as (items[i], items[j]) with i < j, in that order. Symptom: pairs([1, 2, 3]) returns [(1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 1), (2, 3), (3, 1), (3, 2)] — each pair shows up twice, once reversed — expected [(1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3)]. Note positions are what is distinct, not values: pairs(['a', 'a']) is [('a', 'a')]. Do not change the signature.
